admission.justification: Realized across cli/__main__.py, cli/provider_limit_hold.py, and serving/paseo/provider_limits.py, proven by the two CLI tests in mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_suppression.py (with serving/_app_lifespan.py CLI-import isolation checked by mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_layering.py).

applicability: Operator inspection and manual override of active provider-limit windows through agents-remember provider-limits.
conditions: cli/provider_limit_hold.py parses --config and status, suppress, and unsuppress selectors, emits JSON, returns exit codes 0 (success), 2 (config, selector, or non-live refusal), or 1 (filesystem or unexpected error), and routes every mutation exclusively through serving.paseo.provider_limits under provider-limits.lock.
suppress refuses non-live reports, unknown windows, and omitted --window on multi-window reports by name; unsuppress removes named suppressions so later reads judge the window normally.
exclusions: No dashboard UI button or MCP tool mutates provider-limit suppressions.
The CLI adapter performs no direct writes to provider-limits.json or provider-limit-suppressions.json.
statement: The agents-remember provider-limits runtime command provides JSON status, suppress, and unsuppress sub-actions (exit 0/1/2) refusing non-live reports/windows by name and routing every file mutation exclusively through serving.paseo.provider_limits under provider-limits.lock.
title: Runtime provider-limits CLI exposes JSON actions via single serving writer
